VI.description: Round15 P15 v2: the type-launderer chain. seed (class constant) feeds Sensor:Scale By, whose obj out is a SENSOR-typed wire; that wire feeds Sensor:Tag. Because Tag's input arrives parent-typed, the editor cannot bind it at edit time, so the runtime value (a Temp Sensor) must select the implementation - dynamic dispatch, observed. answer=Temp Sensor with both calls still on Sensor members proves it.
